instruction.thesis: HYPE spot at 48.07 is +2.21% from entry (47.03), peak was +3.40%, and we are approaching the +4% target. The short-squeeze dynamic has largely played out: funding snapped from -44.7% back to +10.95% (normalization complete), OI is at record highs but momentum is decelerating (trajectory shows 47.50→47.29→47.40→47.70→47.34→47.55→48.33→47.60→47.82→47.99→48.07 — choppy near the high). The PM $50 YES contract at 0.855 (underlying cap 0.961) signals the market sees ~89% chance of touching $50 by year-end, but near-term the spot is stalling below $50. Taking profit near the peak rather than waiting for the mechanical +4% target given the deceleration signal.
